page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using AMD EPYC 9T24 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. Provisioned under a KVM hypervisor, this system delivers 192 dedicated virtual CPUs along with 384.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core.

The hardware configuration provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput networking requirements. It does not include local NVMe or SSD storage drives, relying entirely on network-attached storage architectures. Additionally, the instance contains zero dedicated GPU accelerators and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and 2.0 GB per core ratio, the instance is positioned for CPU-bound compute tasks, large-scale batch processing, and parallelized execution frameworks. The resource distribution favors compute density over local storage capacity, providing a cost-effective hardware balance for high-concurrency, scale-out enterprise workloads.
